## Current caption

> The deflection of the vertical: a dense rock mass deflects the local plumb line away from the true radial direction toward Earth's center. At Greenwich, such mass anomalies cause a deflection of approximately 5.3 arcseconds, producing the 102-meter offset between astronomical and geodetic meridians.
